# Salima's Kitchen

> A food blog celebrating authentic Moroccan and Puerto Rican cuisine through recipes, cooking techniques, and cultural storytelling by Salima Benkhalti.

Salima's Kitchen is a culinary resource dedicated to traditional recipes from Morocco and Puerto Rico, featuring both classic dishes and modern interpretations. The site combines detailed recipe guides, cultural context, and curated kitchen product recommendations for home cooks interested in Caribbean and North African cuisines.

## Key Topics

- Puerto Rican cuisine
- Moroccan recipes
- Mojo Rojo
- Yuca con Mojo
- Mofongo
- Sancocho

- Latin cuisine

- Cultural cooking

## Recipe Collection

- [Browse Recipes - Salima's Kitchen](https://salimaskitchen.com/browse-recipes): Browse collection of Moroccan & Puerto Rican recipes including Mojo Rojo and Yuca con Mojo
- [Traditional Puerto Rican Mofongo (25 Minutes!)](https://salimaskitchen.com/mofongo): Quick 25-minute Puerto Rican mofongo with green plantains and chicharrones
- [Stewed Sancocho (Puerto Rican Beef & Root Veggie Stew)](https://salimaskitchen.com/sancocho): Caribbean sancocho stew recipe with beef, chicken, root vegetables, and corn
- [5 Ingredient Empanada Dough](https://salimaskitchen.com/empanada-dough): 5-ingredient Puerto Rican empanada dough recipe for pastelillos and more
- [Super Easy Pizza Empanadas (Empanadillas de Pizza)](https://salimaskitchen.com/pizza-empanadas): Easy Puerto Rican pizza empanadas with cheese, sauce, and garlic butter
- [Steamed Yuca with Garlic (Yuca con Mojo)](https://salimaskitchen.com/yuca-con-mojo): Classic Caribbean yuca con mojo with garlic lime sauce and onions
- [Mojo Rojo (Quick Red Pepper Sauce)](https://salimaskitchen.com/mojo-rojo): 5-minute Canarian red pepper sauce with fresh peppers, vinegar, and garlic

## Moroccan & Mediterranean Dishes

- [Moroccan-Style White Fish Stew With Potatoes](https://salimaskitchen.com/white-fish-stew): Authentic Moroccan white fish stew with potatoes, carrots, and peppers
- [Honey Harissa Carrots with Garlic Yogurt](https://salimaskitchen.com/harissa-carrots): Roasted honey harissa carrots with garlic Greek yogurt Mediterranean side
- [Classic Spanish Red Sangria (6 Servings)](https://salimaskitchen.com/red-sangria): Classic Spanish red sangria pitcher cocktail with wine, citrus, and apples

## Desserts & Sweets

- [Classic Puerto Rican Flan Recipe](https://salimaskitchen.com/puerto-rican-flan-recipe): Mom's classic Puerto Rican flan dessert with creamy custard and caramel
